features.name: Append (INSERT)
features.description: Appends incoming records to an Iceberg table as new data files in an atomic, committed snapshot

features.name: Upsert / Delete (CDC)
features.description: Applies updates and deletes from the source stream to existing rows (upsert / change data capture), not only appends

features.name: Merge-on-Read
features.description: Records updates and deletes as delete files that readers merge at query time instead of rewriting data files. Rated on whether the tool writes in this mode

features.name: Equality Deletes
features.description: Writes delete files that match rows by key columns, the usual mechanism for streaming upserts. Rated on whether the tool can write equality delete files

features.name: Position Deletes
features.description: Writes delete files that point at a data file and row position. Rated on whether the tool can write position delete files

features.name: Deletion Vectors
features.description: Puffin-based binary deletion vectors that replace V2 position delete files. Rated on whether the tool can write deletion vectors

features.name: Table Creation (auto-create)
features.description: Creates the destination table, and its namespace, from the incoming record schema when it does not exist

features.name: Schema Evolution (auto)
features.description: Adds new columns to the destination table when the incoming records carry fields the table does not have

features.name: Type Promotion / Widening
features.description: Widens a column's type (for example int to long) when incoming values no longer fit

features.name: Table Maintenance (compaction)
features.description: Compacts small files, expires snapshots or removes orphan files. Ingestion creates many small files, so this matters

features.name: Branching & Tagging
features.description: Commits to a named branch instead of main, enabling write-audit-publish workflows

features.name: Hidden Partitioning
features.description: Writes partitioned tables using partition transforms (day, hour, bucket, truncate) without extra partition columns in the data

features.name: Catalog Integration
features.description: Commits to Iceberg tables through an Iceberg catalog

features.name: AWS Glue Catalog
features.description: Writes to Iceberg tables registered in the AWS Glue Data Catalog

features.name: REST Catalog
features.description: Writes to Iceberg tables through the Iceberg REST catalog protocol

features.name: Variant Type
features.description: Writes semi-structured data into the V3 variant type

features.name: Shredded Variant
features.description: Writes variant data with shredded Parquet columns for faster reads
